title: Relative pronouns: who / which / that / where / whose / when / why

items.q: The developer ___ fixed the bug works at our company.
That's the tool ___ lets you track memory leaks.
The office ___ we used to work has been renovated.
The project manager, ___ name I always forget, will join us later.
The app ___ interface is more intuitive is more popular.
The library, ___ was built by the former government, is huge.
items.e: Non-defining (entre comas) → nunca that; cosa → which.

items.q: That was the moment ___ everything stopped working.
I don't know the reason ___ the build failed.
She is the colleague ___ laptop I borrowed.
A browser is a program ___ lets you access the internet.

title: ¿Se puede omitir el pronombre relativo?
instructions: Mirá lo que sigue al pronombre en negrita: ¿un verbo (es sujeto) o un sujeto nuevo (es objeto)?

items.q: The shirt **that** I bought was too expensive.
items.e: Después viene 'I' (sujeto propio) → that es objeto → se puede omitir.

items.q: She's the developer **who** fixed the bug.
items.e: Después viene un verbo → who es sujeto → no se omite.

items.q: The bug **that** she fixed was critical.
The program **that** runs in the background is using too much memory.
The framework **which** we use every day is Laravel.
Mark Zuckerberg, **who** founded Facebook, wears grey T-shirts.
items.e: Non-defining: nunca se omite (y además who es sujeto).

title: Completá con el pronombre relativo
instructions: Escribí who / which / that / where / whose / when / why según corresponda.
text:
1. She is the person [1] looks after our networks.
2. It's a chip [2] controls a computer.
3. That's the man [3] dog bit me.
4. This is the place [4] I first learned Python.
5. The reason [5] he left was a mystery.
6. That was the year [6] they launched the app.
7. Python, [7] was created in 1991, is still very popular.
8. Mark, [8] is the founder of the company, always wears grey.

title: Definí términos IT con relative clauses
instructions: Completá cada definición con el pronombre relativo (who / that / which / where).
text:
1. A search bar: It's a tool [1] you type what you're looking for.
2. A printer: It's a device [2] prints documents.
3. A CPU: It's a chip [3] controls a computer.
4. A developer: It's a person [4] writes code.
5. A repository: It's a place [5] a project's code is stored.

items.e: Ejemplo de tus apuntes: 'a tool where you type...'.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: Mark Zuckerberg, that is the founder of Facebook, wears grey.
Mark Zuckerberg, who is the founder of Facebook, wears grey.
Mark Zuckerberg, which is the founder of Facebook, wears grey.
items.a: Mark Zuckerberg, who is the founder of Facebook, wears grey.
items.e: Non-defining: who/which, nunca that. Persona → who.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: The person which called was rude.
The person who called was rude.
The person whose called was rude.
items.a: The person who called was rude.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: She is the developer who she fixed it.
She is the developer who fixed it.
She is the developer fixed it.
items.a: She is the developer who fixed it.
items.e: No se repite el sujeto; y who (sujeto) no se omite.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: The shirt which I bought it was expensive.
The shirt which I bought was expensive.
The shirt I bought it was expensive.
items.a: The shirt which I bought was expensive.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: Python, which was created in 1991, is popular.
Python, that was created in 1991, is popular.
Python, who was created in 1991, is popular.
items.a: Python, which was created in 1991, is popular.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: The place where I went it was amazing.
The place where I went was amazing.
The place which I went was amazing.
items.a: The place where I went was amazing.
items.e: Lugar → where, y no se repite 'it'.

title: Reduced relative clauses y participle clauses

items.q: There were lots of people ___ at the party.
items.e: who were dancing → dancing (participio presente, sentido activo).

items.q: The developer ___ on this feature is very experienced.
The presents ___ to the children are all hand-made.
items.e: which are given → given (participio pasado, sentido pasivo).

items.q: Decisions ___ in a rush are often regretted later.
The files ___ in the folder are old.
items.e: Los archivos son almacenados → participio pasado.

items.q: The team ___ the release is under pressure.
items.e: who is preparing → preparing (el equipo hace la acción).

items.q: ___ very tired, they decided to go straight home.
items.e: Participle clause de razón (as they were tired).

items.q: ___ the coat, she asked her friend's opinion.
